Montenegro
Consular help: Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Podgorica, Montenegro
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular passport NO
Regular biometric passport NO
Service/Official biometric passport NO
Diplomatic biometric passport NO
Citizens of the Montenegro are exempted from the visa requirement when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina up to 90 days, for a period of six months, starting from the day of entry.
Embassy issues visas to persons from Kosovo, holders of UNMIK passports purposes of entry, exit or passing through the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina.
